$Comment: The map that floats over a character whose errand this player is still on: a quest taken from them, or one whose next step comes back to them, with work still to do. Icon is the one picture every surface reads (an item id floats as that item, a Common-rooted TexturePath is drawn on a flat card); the item named here is a marker item under Server/Item/Items/Ziggfreed/Markers/, a child of the vanilla item that draws the same picture and carries the coloured halo (its ItemEntity.ParticleSystemId, the glow vanilla draws around a dropped item of that rarity), because the halo is read off the item and never off the entity. Scale is the size relative to a full item, Offset lifts it above the top of the character's head in blocks (1.1 clears a tall headdress), and Spin lets the client's own dropped-item motion play at no server cost. Override this file by id from a pack to change the look; override the marker item by id to change only the glow. Which situation shows which look is set in Server/ZiggfreedCommon/QuestIndicators/Default.json and in any quest's own Indicator block. This situation ships switched off (QuestIndicators/Default.json sets InProgress.Overhead.Enabled false), so a character where only a carried quest applies shows nothing and any higher situation still shows; to float this map, set that leaf true in a pack's own Default.json, in mods/ziggfreedcommon/quest-indicators.json under the key Default, or on one quest's Indicator block.
